cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate by C1: defining anionic Sodium Laureth Sulfate @2 (ether type) with two prominent buffers directly after it (Cocamidopropyl Betaine @3, Coco-Glucoside @4) and no reinforcing strong anionic. Textbook C1 case.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Moderate: one meaningful conditioning system (Hydroxypropyl Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride @8, before the salt) plus light routes (Glyceryl Oleate @6, Ascorbyl Palmitate @14, Panthenol @11, Glycerin @15). C2 not met: no silicone, no payload lipid (Glyceryl Oleate is weak_refatter and cannot take the silicone's place), no pearlizing/fatty route. Low is the realistic neighbor if the guar dose is small.

excluded: Sorbitan Caprylate @7 (sorbitan ester preservative booster/solubilizer, no deposition role)
Citrus Aurantium Peel Oil @22 (essential oil, fragrance, 6.4)

weightPotential.depositionLoad: light: one cationic guar polymer and two weak refatters; no silicone, oil, film or protein.
weightPotential.persistence: low: guar deposition is the only persistent route and is light without silicone/lipid partners.
weightPotential.resetCapacity: moderate: C1 SLES chassis buffered by betaine and glucoside.
weightPotential.counterevidence: The guar @8 is listed before Sodium Chloride @9, so its dose may be meaningful; two deposition families present (cationic_polymer, weak_refatter).
weightPotential.whyThisBand: Low: a single cationic guar with weak refatters only, facing an effective SLES reset, does not support noticeable loss of movement.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not moderate (W2): the second family is only weak_refatter (Glyceryl Oleate @6, Ascorbyl Palmitate @14), there is no silicone, payload lipid, film former or protein to converge with the guar, and the SLES/betaine/glucoside reset faces only this light route.
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: Unknown guar dose; an early, high-charge guar could leave noticeable residue (moderate).
weightPotential.rationale: Low: one cationic polymer @8 plus weak refatters against a moderate C1 reset; no payload lipid (W-line @11 irrelevant).
